# 01-convert-DataAnalyzer: Convert DataAnalyzer

Convert DataAnalyzer\DataAnalyzer.csproj to SDK-style (Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop)
   - Migrate packages.config → PackageReference (or preserve if migration fails)
   - Replace explicit <Compile> includes with SDK globs
   - Add <UseWindowsForms>true</UseWindowsForms>
   - Preserve assembly attributes (remove duplicates if AssemblyInfo is autogenerated)
   - Verify build in Visual Studio 2026; fix missing package references
   - Done when: project file is SDK-style, builds clean in Debug/Release, packages.config removed

## Scope Inventory
- Projects affected: DataAnalyzer (DataAnalyzer\DataAnalyzer.csproj)
- Distinct concerns:
  - Project file format conversion (legacy → SDK-style)
  - packages.config migration to PackageReference
  - WinForms-specific properties and resource handling (.resx, designer files)
  - External package references pointing to ..\StressStrainData\packages (ZedGraph hint path)
- Files noted for review (from project file):
  - FileReader.cs, FileWriter.cs, MainForm.cs (+ designer), Math\*.cs, Plots\*.cs, Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, Properties\Resources.resx, packages.config, App.config
- Skills loaded: converting-to-sdk-style, building-projects, managing-package-references

## Initial Research Findings
- DataAnalyzer.csproj is non-SDK-style (has ToolsVersion and explicit Compile includes)
- packages.config is present and referenced in the project
- There is a HintPath referencing a packages folder at "..\StressStrainData\packages\ZedGraph.5.1.7\lib\net35-Client\ZedGraph.dll" — package management may be outside this project folder
- The project targets .NET Framework v4.8 and is a WinForms app; conversion should use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop with UseWindowsForms=true and keep TargetFrameworkVersion as v4.8

## Next Actions
1. Use the SDK-style conversion tool to convert DataAnalyzer.csproj (one project at a time)
2. After conversion, build the project using msbuild.exe (per building-projects guidance, because target is net48 and resx resources exist)
3. If packages are missing, migrate packages.config to PackageReference via managing-package-references guidance and restore
4. Fix any build warnings and errors; document changes in progress-details.md
